required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
required.summary: Public Supabase project URL used by browser and server auth clients.

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
required.summary: Public Supabase anon key used by browser and middleware auth clients.

optional.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
optional.summary: Enables username lookup, admin-only recovery helpers, and QA automation paths.

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
optional.summary: Canonical application origin for auth redirect flows.

optional.name: APP_URL
optional.summary: Server-only fallback origin when NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is not set.

optional.name: LEGACY_SUPABASE_URL
optional.summary: Legacy source Supabase URL used only during controlled migration flows.

optional.name: LEGACY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
optional.summary: Legacy source anon key used only during controlled migration flows.

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_CURATED_ONBOARDING
optional.summary: Optional feature flag for curated onboarding experiments.

notes: Wave 2A keeps the canonical public Supabase pair explicit while leaving migration-only legacy vars optional.
